Cheers!

Edit: 26042013

Summary of my trading style: HTF Demand/Supply - Engulfing on H1 or higher - Find the DP/origin of the move on LTFs - Pending order

Edit: 200713

I will save you some time, if you want to learn about my way of trading, start reading from PAGE 4.
Don't worry sunny, we have all been there. Congrats on the first step and keep studying. Don't be afraid to ask any questions, we can all learn something.

GBPUSD trade setup:

Monthly on GBPUSD for me the bias is up, clearly pointing to the supply far up in the heavens.

DAILY: On the daily chart, price has been in an uptrend since July 2012, currently standing at a place from where it was rejected twice earlier, April 2012 and September 2012, Currently also, price is starting to project weakness, having been rejected for the third time in December.

Image 1: Daily linegraph for trendline and S/R flip. Black thick line is the S/R flip.

Image 2: Daily chart showing rejections of the price from the supply zone. The supply zone marked in green happens to be the Weekly and Daily supply zone.

Image 3: H4 chart. The take home message for me from this chart is break of the uptrend by the engulf of the source of the final upmove shown in light blue rectangle.

The white areas in the green zone are the untouched decisions made by the price to move lower.

Image4: M30 chart shows the decision made by the price to break the S/R line. Decision is marked in Golden color. The price is now compressing into the decision.

Image5: M5 chart helps us to zoom into the area where it was decided price is too expensive to go above the S/R flip and price moved further down.

Image 6: Target for the trade

In the event of the failure of the trade setup, the next setup would be to trade the untouched decision points shown on the H4 chart.

Advice and comments welcome!
